name: Launch Art Portfolio
description: Guides the user through launching a professional art or creative portfolio from curation through outreach, chaining 5 atomic skills across career-development, design-creative, and writing categories. Covers physical vs. digital portfolio, platform selection, fine art vs. commercial positioning, and curated vs. comprehensive approaches. Use when the user wants to create and launch a portfolio to attract clients, galleries, or employers. Do NOT use for building a job search portfolio in non-creative fields (use land-new-job workflow), personal brand content strategy (use build-personal-brand workflow), or creating the artwork itself.
